'''Revelation Endor Operations/Rebel Outpost...WHAT''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 8 November 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 EOps Revelation DS 2002 EndorOpe.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Please rate this deck. I want to see if the changes made it more 'balanced'. By the way, the title is a joke : ).

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

I tried to modify this deck to be tracking-friendly; I just started tracking and aren't too good yet, though. To grouchyolduncleowen: I tried to balance this deck. To Cam Solusar: I'll take that into account, but I LIKE Saber Squadron.
